Placeholder. How many chunks out from the camera's own chunk are built and shown, in every direction. R6b: sized to what the camera can actually see at its maximum zoom-out (about 320 m), plus one chunk of margin - zoom-out is limited by design, so chunks further out are never built or rendered.

Placeholder. Above this camera height, chunks show a flat, low-detail view with no grid lines, so performance stays smooth when zoomed far out. R6b: kept above the camera's maximum zoom height (100 m) so it can't trigger; left in place for when zoom is extended again later.
